validity_findings.finding: Redesigned Fix3 correctly fixes overbroadness (C1 True, C2 False, C3 False, C4 old True) and URL corpus 12/12 passes, but hypothesis bullet 4 'independently necessary over Fix2' is not demonstrated. For any non-trivial prefix, Fix2 and Fix3 are mutually exclusive: bare authority 'https://api.example.com' has Fix2 False (ends 'm') and Fix3 True; valid query prefix 'https://api.example.com?key=' has Fix2 True (ends '=') and Fix3 False; path-slash has Fix2 True Fix3 False. No prefix satisfies Fix2 passes AND Fix3 rejects except trivial scheme-only 'https://' (rest '' -> Fix3 True, _validate_prefix_boundary '' -> False, but this discriminant is not in corpus and not tested via distill). Distill pipeline Fix3 check precedes Fix2, so Fix3 blocks bare authority first, but Fix2 would also block it if reached. Producer's C7 'discriminating test' actually shows old Fix3 overbroad vs new Fix3 accept, not Fix2 vs Fix3 necessity.

This fixes parent V2_FIX3_OVERBROAD for host?query patterns. Does NOT demonstrate Fix3 independent necessity over Fix2 for bare authority (Fix2 already rejects because last char not in /?=&; mutual exclusivity holds for all non-trivial prefixes, only scheme-only 'https://' discriminant untested). Claim ceiling expands only to 'single-slot GET with host?query or path-slash on jsonplaceholder deterministic synthetic data, n=3 HTTP verification'. Does NOT support multi-slot, PUT/POST, noisy browser, LLM distillation, cross-site, or product economics. C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL (not VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE); C-PRODUCT-ECON remains HYPOTHESIS.
